# Templates and drafts (not published)

Everything here is a **draft for trustee review**. Nothing is in `src/`, so none of it is built or deployed. Square-bracket items `[LIKE THIS]` are blanks that must be filled with real, verified information. Do not guess them, and do not publish a page with any bracket left.

| File | Purpose | Needs before use |
|---|---|---|
| `governance-page.md` | Draft copy for a future governance page | Trustee decisions: registration number, trustee names, address |
| `complaints-policy-draft.md` | Draft complaints policy | Trustee adoption; legal/regulator wording check |
| `drop-page-template.md` | Layout and fields for a single Drop page | A real, verified Drop |
| `close-out-report-template.md` | One-page close-out for each Drop | A completed Drop and its evidence |
| `donation-wording-draft.md` | Pre-donation wording (split, surplus, shortfall, refunds, Gift Aid) | Legal/fundraising-regulation review; payment provider chosen; registration |
| `partner-due-diligence-checklist.md` | Checklist for vetting a delivery partner | A candidate partner; trustees' risk appetite |
| `form-and-newsletter-test-plan.md` | Manual live test of the contact form and newsletter | Raf (needs a real inbox and submission) |

None of this is legal advice. The Charity Commission and Fundraising Regulator guidance referenced in the strategy notes has not been re-checked against current publications in this session; trustees should confirm against the source documents.
